unit.description: Verify pure string normalization and collection behavior in the library, including compatibility tests. Browser components, SQL migrations, API specifications and generated clients are outside this task.

ui.description: Verify browser component interactions, accessibility and visual styling in the web application. Pure library helpers, SQL migrations and API schema validation are outside this task.

schema.description: Verify SQL schemas, migration execution, indexes and database constraints. Pure library behavior, browser styling and API documentation are outside this task.

api.description: Verify the API specification and generated TypeScript client agree, including request and response shapes. Pure library tests, browser styling and SQL migration checks are outside this task.
